item.title: Soul-A-Go-Go at the Brunswick Ballroom
item.description: Soul-A-Go-Go at the Brunswick Ballroom Sat 11 Apr 2026 Naarm/Melbourne’s legendary soul party Soul-A-Go-Go is back for a one-off night of dancing and rare grooves at the Brunswick Ballroom on Saturday April 11, from 9pm ‘til 3am.

item.title: 25 Years of Burning Bitumen live at The Bergy Bandroom
item.description: 25 Years of Burning Bitumen live at The Bergy Bandroom Sat 9 May 2026 PBS Presents Burning Bitumen 's Birthday Bonaza '25 Years of Evil'. To celebrate, we are bringing some of the scene's heaviest bands to rattle your bones at The Bergy Bandroom on Saturday May 9.

item.title: Shabaka - Of The Earth
item.description: Shabaka - Of The Earth Mon 2 Mar 2026 to Sun 8 Mar 2026 This week’s PBS Feature Album is Of The Earth, the debut release from instrumentalist/producer Shabaka.

item.title: Listen back: International Women's Day 2026
item.description: Listen back: International Women's Day 2026 Sun 8 Mar 2026 Sunday March 8 is International Women’s Day! To mark the occasion, PBS has programmed a full 24 hours of radio celebrating the incredible women and gender diverse musicians and DJs in our community.

item.title: IKSRE and Nat Bartsch Studio 5 Live
item.description: IKSRE and Nat Bartsch Studio 5 Live Sun 8 Mar 2026 This International Women’s Day, PBS presents a very special Studio 5 Live with pianist/composer Nat Bartsch and loops based artist IKSRE - together for a live collaboration. Nat Bartsch and I K S R E Studio 5 Live on Soak Tune in on Sunday March 8 from 7pm

item.title: JOLT Arts Autumn Season 2026
item.description: JOLT Arts Autumn Season 2026 Sat 7 Mar 2026 to Sun 31 May 2026 Running from March through May, the JOLT Autumn Season spans everything from avant garde noise to classical Indian tabla, acousmatic opera to stand-up comedy; all threaded through JOLT’s commitment to neurodiverse artists and pushing sound...
